title: Data Scientist and AI Specialist
description:
### **about the role**


we are seeking an innovative and driven **data scientist / ai specialist** to join our advanced technology team. in this role, you will architect, build, and deploy cutting\-edge ai solutions powered by large language models (llms), vector databases, and knowledge graphs. you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between raw unstructured data and intelligent, context\-aware applications that drive business impact.

### **key responsibilities**

* **llm integration \& fine\-tuning:** design, implement, and optimize applications utilizing large language models (llms) via apis and open\-source frameworks (e.g., langchain, llamaindex).
* **vector database architecture:** architect, manage, and scale vector search infrastructure (e.g., pinecone, milvus, qdrant, weaviate, pgvector) for high\-performance semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) pipelines.
* **knowledge graph development:** design and construct knowledge graphs to structure complex domain data, integrating them with llms and vector search to improve reasoning and context retrieval (graphrag).
* **python scripting \& pipeline automation:** write robust, production\-ready python code to automate data ingestion, preprocessing, embedding generation, and model evaluation.
* **collaboration \& deployment:** work closely with cross\-functional teams (software engineers, data engineers, and product managers) to deploy ai models into scalable cloud production environments.

### **required qualifications**

* **experience:** 3\+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or artificial intelligence, with a strong focus on nlp and generative ai.
* **programming:** advanced proficiency in **python** scripting and modern ml libraries
* **education:** bs in technical domain

title: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer (Remote in CA)
description:
**who we are**
--------------


join a team that puts its people first! as a member of the first american family of companies, first american trust is a federal savings bank that has provided banking, wealth management, and trust solutions on a national, full\-service basis for more than five decades. since 1889, first american (nyse: faf) has held an unwavering belief in its people. they are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the fortune 100 best companies to work for® list for eleven consecutive years. we have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and lgbtq\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. first american will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. for more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**what we do**
--------------


we are seeking a highly skilled full stack senior software engineer to design and implement secure, scalable, cloud\-native software solutions that power next\-generation financial applications. in this role, you will contribute hands\-on development while supporting architecture and design decisions across modern web applications, apis, and distributed services. if you are passionate about exploring new technologies and have a demonstrated track record of delivering innovative features and products, we would like to hear from you. you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product, architecture, ux, devops, and security, to design, develop, and integrate ai\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent automation, llm\-powered services, rag\-based solutions, and api\-driven ai integrations. you will help translate emerging ideas into reliable, production\-ready systems that deliver measurable business value. this position offers the opportunity to work with a talented team while operating autonomously with minimal supervision. a strong background in modern software development, cloud platforms, and agile methodologies is essential. experience building, integrating, or operating ai\-powered applications, and using ai\-assisted development tools to improve delivery, is highly valued.**what you'll do:**

* design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable applications in an azure cloud environment.
* build full\-stack solutions using python, react, javascript/typescript, rest apis, and microservice architectures.
* modify and enhance existing applications; contribute to product delivery through coding and pull request reviews.
* design, develop, and integrate ai\-powered capabilities, including llm integrations, rag, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation, using platforms such as azure openai.
* implement and maintain ai orchestration and inference pipelines, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, observability, and responsible usage.
* apply software engineering best practices (testing, monitoring, ci/cd, observability, secure sdlc) to production systems, including ai\-driven applications.

* ensure data privacy, security, governance, and compliance when building and deploying ai\-enabled functionality.
* independently define and prioritize goals and tasks in a fast\-paced agile product environment with small, focused teams.
* collaborate with solution architects and stakeholders to align on design plans, troubleshoot production issues, and drive durable solutions.
* mentor engineers on software engineering best practices, cloud\-native architecture, and ai integration patterns.
* propose solutions to complex problems, build consensus among the team, and influence technical direction.

**what you'll bring:**

* 5\+ years of software development experience using python and building cloud\-native applications in azure (aws experience also considered).
* experience developing modern web applications with react and javascript/typescript.
* strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, software design patterns, and application architecture.
* experience designing and consuming rest apis.
* experience working with relational databases (postgresql, sql server, mysql).
* experience conducting code reviews and mentoring other engineers.
* experience working in agile development environments.
* familiarity with ci/cd, devops, and modern software development best practices.
* experience integrating ai capabilities into applications, including azure openai, llms, rag, or vector databases.
* experience with docker and kubernetes preferred.
* excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
* bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**technology:** python, azure (app services, functions, azure openai, ai services), react, javascript/typescript, rest api, relational databases (postgresql, mysql, sql server), nosql databases (mongodb, cosmos db), llms, rag, ai apis.

**development tools:** docker, kubernetes, linux, windows, azure, git, gitlab, github, azure devops, npm package management, ci/cd pipelines.

title: Cyber - SecOps - Consultant
description:
if you're looking for an opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, data, and artificial intelligence, deloitte's cyber defense \& resilience team offers the scale, complexity, and growth environment to build your career. in this role, you will support organizations as they modernize security operations through advanced analytics, cyber data engineering, and ai\-enabled capabilities. you will work with leading technologies and help clients strengthen cyber defense while enabling innovation across the enterprise.  

  

recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026\.  

  

**work you'll do**  

  

as a cyber secops consultant on the cyber defense \& resilience team, you will be responsible for...  

* supporting the design and modernization of cyber data and analytics programs that improve organizational intelligence and enable scalable delivery models
* developing and applying analytics, machine learning, and data science techniques to cyber use cases across security operations, threat detection, and incident response
* working with technologies such as databricks for cyber, aws security lake, google secops, splunk, crowdstrike, and palo alto networks to support cyber data platforms and operational outcomes
* assisting with the maintenance, enhancement, governance, and administration of data platforms and applications using standardized, automated, and ai\-enabled dataops capabilities
* contributing to ai and analytics initiatives by helping clients experiment, operationalize, and scale solutions using cyber and information technology telemetry data

  

a successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* effective written and verbal communication skills
* meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* ability to lead projects or workstreams
* ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* ability to meet deadlines
* ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**the team**  

  

cyber defense \& resilience is an integrated team of security and data technologists working at the intersection of cybersecurity, advanced cyber data engineering, and the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning for cyber defense and operations. the team serves as a trusted advisor and managed service provider, bringing capability and capacity across security data modernization, dataops, ai, and machine learning to address cyber\-specific challenges.  

  

cyber detect \& respond practitioners work with clients to modernize large\-scale cyber data and analytics programs, support embedded and as\-a\-service delivery models, and strengthen day\-to\-day security operations. the team also helps clients harness technologies such as databricks for cyber, aws security lake, google secops, splunk, crowdstrike, and palo alto networks while advancing ai and analytics capabilities through scalable assets, curated datasets, and operational experience.  

  

**qualifications**  

  

required:  

* 2\+ years of analytics consulting or industry experience
* 2\+ years of experience with artificial intelligence development tools, including vector databases such as pinecone or elastic, and development frameworks such as langchain or crewai
* 2\+ years of experience in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data mining
* 2\+ years of experience using statistical computer languages such as python, structured query language (sql), r, or sas to prepare data for analysis, perform exploratory analysis, generate features, and support data science workflows
* 2\+ years of experience using cloud\-based cybersecurity platforms such as google secops, amazon web services (aws), or microsoft azure
* 1\+ years of experience with security operations center threat hunting and incident response
* experience supporting at least one full lifecycle analytics engagement across strategy, design, and implementation
* bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, or statistics, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience
* ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

  

preferred:  

* experience architecting, designing, developing, and deploying enterprise data science solutions that include natural language processing (nlp), chatbots, virtual assistants, computer vision, cognitive services, and big data tools used to manage large datasets
* experience applying artificial intelligence (ai), machine learning (ml), and advanced data engineering to cybersecurity use cases, including detection and cyber threat response acceleration
* experience parsing and normalizing cybersecurity or information technology telemetry datasets
* experience using python machine learning and deep learning frameworks and libraries, including pytorch, keras, tensorflow, scikit\-learn, numpy, and scipy
* experience designing and implementing apache open\-source frameworks, including kafka, storm, and spark, to support end\-to\-end data management lifecycle activities
* experience managing multiple concurrent task assignments and developing presentation materials using microsoft visio and microsoft powerpoint

  

the wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. at deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. a reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 \- $162,800\.  

  

you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

if you're looking for an opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, data, and artificial intelligence, deloitte's cyber defense \& resilience team offers the scale, complexity, and growth environment to build your career. in this role, you will support organizations as they modernize security operations through advanced analytics, cyber data engineering, and ai\-enabled capabilities. you will work with leading technologies and help clients strengthen cyber defense while enabling innovation across the enterprise.  

  

recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026\.  

  

**work you'll do**  

  

as a cyber secops consultant on the cyber defense \& resilience team, you will be responsible for...  

* supporting the design and modernization of cyber data and analytics programs that improve organizational intelligence and enable scalable delivery models
* developing and applying analytics, machine learning, and data science techniques to cyber use cases across security operations, threat detection, and incident response
* working with technologies such as databricks for cyber, aws security lake, google secops, splunk, crowdstrike, and palo alto networks to support cyber data platforms and operational outcomes
* assisting with the maintenance, enhancement, governance, and administration of data platforms and applications using standardized, automated, and ai\-enabled dataops capabilities
* contributing to ai and analytics initiatives by helping clients experiment, operationalize, and scale solutions using cyber and information technology telemetry data

  

a successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* effective written and verbal communication skills
* meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* ability to lead projects or workstreams
* ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* ability to meet deadlines
* ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**the team**  

  

cyber defense \& resilience is an integrated team of security and data technologists working at the intersection of cybersecurity, advanced cyber data engineering, and the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning for cyber defense and operations. the team serves as a trusted advisor and managed service provider, bringing capability and capacity across security data modernization, dataops, ai, and machine learning to address cyber\-specific challenges.  

  

cyber detect \& respond practitioners work with clients to modernize large\-scale cyber data and analytics programs, support embedded and as\-a\-service delivery models, and strengthen day\-to\-day security operations. the team also helps clients harness technologies such as databricks for cyber, aws security lake, google secops, splunk, crowdstrike, and palo alto networks while advancing ai and analytics capabilities through scalable assets, curated datasets, and operational experience.  

  

**qualifications**  

  

required:  

* 2\+ years of analytics consulting or industry experience
* 2\+ years of experience with artificial intelligence development tools, including vector databases such as pinecone or elastic, and development frameworks such as langchain or crewai
* 2\+ years of experience in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data mining
* 2\+ years of experience using statistical computer languages such as python, structured query language (sql), r, or sas to prepare data for analysis, perform exploratory analysis, generate features, and support data science workflows
* 2\+ years of experience using cloud\-based cybersecurity platforms such as google secops, amazon web services (aws), or microsoft azure
* 1\+ years of experience with security operations center threat hunting and incident response
* experience supporting at least one full lifecycle analytics engagement across strategy, design, and implementation
* bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, or statistics, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience
* ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

  

preferred:  

* experience architecting, designing, developing, and deploying enterprise data science solutions that include natural language processing (nlp), chatbots, virtual assistants, computer vision, cognitive services, and big data tools used to manage large datasets
* experience applying artificial intelligence (ai), machine learning (ml), and advanced data engineering to cybersecurity use cases, including detection and cyber threat response acceleration
* experience parsing and normalizing cybersecurity or information technology telemetry datasets
* experience using python machine learning and deep learning frameworks and libraries, including pytorch, keras, tensorflow, scikit\-learn, numpy, and scipy
* experience designing and implementing apache open\-source frameworks, including kafka, storm, and spark, to support end\-to\-end data management lifecycle activities
* experience managing multiple concurrent task assignments and developing presentation materials using microsoft visio and microsoft powerpoint

  

the wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. at deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. a reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 \- $162,800\.  

  

you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

title: AI & Backend Engineer
description:
### **about the role**


we're a small, fast\-moving b2b saas company building ai\-powered agents that resolve complex, technical customer support tickets for enterprise teams. our product learns from historical support data, integrates deeply with existing workflows, and handles everything from autonomous ticket resolution to intelligent escalation with full context.


as an **ai \& backend engineer**, you'll own end\-to\-end features across the full stack — shaping ai\-powered capabilities and scaling the architectures that power our agents. you'll work closely with a tight\-knit product and engineering team and have a direct impact on the direction of a product used by real b2b customers. this is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role at a company of fewer than 15 people.

**visa sponsorship is available for this role.**

### **what you'll do**

* design and implement full\-stack product features from idea to production.
* build and enhance ai features — including llm integrations, prompt engineering, and agent pipelines.
* collaborate with the team to plan, scope, and launch new capabilities.
* help make internal development workflows ai\-native — leveraging ai coding tools to move faster and smarter.

### **what we're looking for**

**must\-haves:**

* 1–4 years of experience in backend or ai engineering (new graduates with strong project experience are welcome).
* proven track record of shipping backend systems or ai features to production.
* experience designing end\-to\-end architectures and building ai\-powered data or model pipelines.
* hands\-on experience integrating with openai models and prompt engineering.
* at least some experience working with or building ai agents.
* familiarity with relational databases (postgresql) and/or firestore (gcp).
* personal hobby projects involving llms or other ai topics — we want to see genuine curiosity.

**strong differentiators:**

* you're a heavy user of ai coding agents (e.g., codex, claude code, cursor) and have concrete ideas — or demonstrated improvements — for optimising ai\-assisted development workflows.
* comfort working across the stack with python (fastapi), typescript/react (next.js), docker, and kubernetes.
* experience at a company building conversational ai, customer support tooling, or b2b saas products.

### **tech stack**

* **backend:** python, fastapi
* **frontend:** typescript, react, next.js
* **ai/ml:** openai models (gpt\-4o, o3, o4\-mini, etc.)
* **databases:** postgresql, firestore (gcp)
* **infrastructure:** docker, kubernetes, gcp, microsoft azure

### **location**


this is a **full\-time, on\-site role** based in **munich, germany**. we work together in person — great for collaboration and moving fast as a small team. visa sponsorship is available.

**decision scientist**
======================


about the role  

the decision scientist will partner with digital product managers, engineering, ux, operations, and analytics teams to drive data\-informed decisions across digital ordering experiences.  

this role combines advanced analytics, experimentation, forecasting, ai\-enabled insights, and business performance analysis to improve digital experiences, operational efficiency, and product outcomes. the ideal candidate brings strong analytical expertise, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations for product leaders and senior executives.

* influence product strategy, roadmap priorities, and investment decisions
* work with large\-scale data across cloud and on\-premises environments
* build ai\-enabled analytics tools and self\-service reporting capabilities
* lead experimentation, forecasting, and product measurement initiatives
* collaborate with cross\-functional product, engineering, ux, and operations teams

**core responsibilities**  

**product analytics and decision support**
* analyze product, operational, transaction, and digital experience performance to identify trends, risks, root causes, and opportunities.
* develop recommendations that influence product prioritization, roadmap planning, feature optimization, and investment decisions.
* build analytical models, forecasts, scenario\-planning tools, and opportunity\-sizing assessments.
* define key performance indicators and monitor product, operational, and business outcomes.
* quantify business impact and measure return on investment for product initiatives.

**experimentation and product measurement**

* design and evaluate a/b tests, pilots, and experiments.
* measure adoption, engagement, conversion, transaction success, operational efficiency, and feature utilization.
* create standardized product measurement frameworks across platforms and channels.
* evaluate pilot results and provide recommendations for broader implementation.

**dashboards, data products, and ai enablement**
* build and maintain product health scorecards, performance dashboards, and automated reporting solutions.
* develop ai\-enabled and self\-service analytics tools for product teams.
* automate recurring analysis, monitoring, and reporting activities.
* partner with data engineering and analytics teams to improve data quality, accessibility, and reporting capabilities.
* enhance existing dashboards and data products based on evolving business needs.

**business problem\-solving and communication**
* lead analysis of complex and ambiguous business questions.
* develop hypotheses, research approaches, measurement plans, and actionable recommendations.
* translate technical analysis into clear business implications.
* create executive\-ready presentations covering performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* present findings to product leadership and senior executives.
* promote best practices in decision science, experimentation, product analytics, and ai\-enabled reporting.

**required qualifications**
* bachelor’s degree in analytics, data science, statistics, economics, business, computer science, or a related field preferred.
* at least four years of experience in strategic analytics, product analytics, or decision support.
* at least five years of experience communicating analytical findings and producing detail\-oriented deliverables.
* advanced proficiency in sql, excel, python, r, sas, tableau, or power bi.
* experience with azure data lake storage, azure sql server, oracle, aws, on\-premises systems, and web\-based data sources.
* experience performing exploratory data analysis, data cleansing, transformation, aggregation, and large\-scale data manipulation.
* knowledge of experimental design, a/b testing, forecasting, and scenario planning.
* ability to explain complex technical findings to non\-technical audiences.
* strong business acumen and understanding of operational and digital product processes.

**technology**
* azure
* oracle
* sql server
* python, r, and sas
* tableau or power bi
* microsoft office suite
* smartsheet

**preferred:** experience with databricks.  

**key success measures**
success may be measured through digital experience performance, order\-entry speed, error rates, adoption, engagement, cart completion, checkout success, payment speed, transaction reliability, order accuracy, throughput, peak\-hour performance, feature utilization, and satisfaction indicators.

title: Backend Software Engineer
description:
**job overview**

dwelr is building a residential intelligence platform designed to make the rental housing market more transparent, accountable, and easier to navigate. our platform brings together tenant\-submitted reports, verified residency information, property records, ownership and management data, municipal violations, supporting documents, remediation history, and ai\-powered analysis to help users better understand rental properties and housing conditions.

we are seeking a **backend software engineer** to design, build, and scale the server\-side systems that power the dwelr platform. this role will focus on backend services, databases, apis, data pipelines, authentication and authorization, third\-party integrations, application security, and platform reliability.

you will help develop the backend foundation supporting dwelr’s current consumer and property\-management workflows as well as future products, including **dwelr index™ and dwelr index ai™**. these products are intended to transform fragmented residential information into structured, evidence\-backed intelligence for renters, housing providers, government partners, institutional customers, and software developers.

unlike a general full\-stack position, this role will concentrate primarily on the platform’s service and data layers. you will collaborate closely with front\-end engineers, data engineers, ai engineers, product contributors, and trust and safety personnel, but advanced front\-end development experience is not required.

this is an early\-stage startup role with meaningful technical ownership. you will help make architecture decisions, establish backend engineering standards, and take systems from initial design through testing, deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.

**what you will work on**

depending on company priorities and your areas of expertise, your work may include:

* core backend services and apis supporting the dwelr web and future mobile applications.
* rental\-property, landlord, property\-management company, ownership, and neighborhood data models.
* address normalization, property matching, duplicate detection, and entity\-resolution systems.
* tenant report, review, residency\-verification, evidence\-submission, and dispute workflows.
* landlord and property\-manager account claiming, identity verification, and portfolio\-management systems.
* public\-record and municipal\-data ingestion pipelines.
* systems for importing, validating, normalizing, reconciling, and updating property\-related records.
* scheduled jobs, background processing, queues, retries, and data\-refresh operations.
* search, filtering, indexing, full\-text search, geospatial queries, and map\-related data services.
* subscription, payment, billing, entitlement, and stripe webhook systems.
* email, account, case\-status, and property\-monitoring notifications.
* trust and safety, moderation, audit\-log, case\-management, and internal administrative systems.
* evidence provenance and source\-tracking infrastructure.
* the dwelr evidence graph and residential knowledge graph.
* backend services supporting ai\-assisted search, retrieval, document analysis, summarization, and property intelligence.
* government, institutional, monitoring, data\-licensing, and developer api products.
* application monitoring, error reporting, security controls, logging, and operational tooling.

**responsibilities**

* design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain backend services supporting dwelr’s applications and data products.
* build secure and well\-documented apis for web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, third\-party integrations, and future institutional customers.
* develop server\-side functionality using technologies appropriate to dwelr’s current architecture, including typescript or javascript, serverless functions, edge services, and postgresql.
* design and maintain postgresql schemas, tables, relationships, constraints, indexes, functions, triggers, views, and migrations.
* write efficient sql queries and investigate slow or resource\-intensive database operations.
* implement authentication, authorization, account permissions, role\-based access, and database\-level security controls.
* develop and maintain row\-level security policies where appropriate.
* build backend workflows for users, renters, landlords, property managers, moderators, administrators, government partners, and institutional customers.
* design reliable public\-record and third\-party data\-ingestion processes.
* create data\-validation and normalization rules that prevent incomplete, malformed, duplicated, or improperly associated records from entering production systems.
* develop address\-matching and entity\-resolution systems that accurately associate records with the correct property, owner, landlord, or property\-management company.
* build idempotent background processes that can safely retry interrupted or unsuccessful operations.
* implement scheduled tasks, queues, event\-driven workflows, webhook handlers, and asynchronous processing where appropriate.
* integrate external services such as stripe, google maps platform, geocoding providers, email services, notification providers, analytics systems, and municipal data sources.
* build and maintain stripe checkout, subscription, billing, entitlement, and webhook functionality.
* create systems for tracking the origin, status, update time, and reliability of records used throughout the platform.
* maintain audit trails for sensitive actions, administrative decisions, data changes, disputes, and verification events.
* help establish backend infrastructure for the dwelr evidence graph and residential knowledge graph.
* support ai and retrieval systems by providing structured, permission\-aware, source\-linked data services.
* work with ai and data contributors to ensure generated or calculated outputs can be connected to the appropriate underlying evidence.
* implement safeguards that prevent ai\-generated information from being treated as verified source data without appropriate validation.
* develop search, filtering, pagination, indexing, and caching systems that perform reliably as the platform’s data volume grows.
* apply rate limits, validation rules, access controls, and other protections to public and private apis.
* protect sensitive user information, verification materials, account data, evidence, and internal administrative records.
* develop secure file and document metadata workflows, including access restrictions, retention rules, and deletion procedures.

we value demonstrated technical ability and meaningful project experience. candidates may qualify through professional employment, startup work, substantial independent projects, open\-source contributions, or another credible body of production\-oriented work.

experience with any of the following would be beneficial but is not required:

**what success looks like**

a successful backend software engineer at dwelr will:

* deliver complete and dependable backend systems rather than isolated code changes.
* build apis that are understandable, consistent, secure, and easy for other engineers to use.
* create database structures that maintain data integrity as the platform grows.
* build ingestion pipelines that handle incomplete, inconsistent, duplicated, and changing source data safely.
* ensure important records remain connected to their sources, update history, and applicable evidence.
* improve the platform’s reliability, security, performance, and observability.
* identify permission, privacy, security, or data\-quality risks before they reach production.
* develop systems that fail predictably and can recover safely from interrupted operations.
* write code and documentation that future engineers can understand and maintain.
* make architecture decisions based on actual product and scale requirements rather than unnecessary complexity.
* communicate openly when technical debt, data limitations, or system constraints affect a proposed feature.
* help establish backend standards that support dwelr’s consumer, government, institutional, and ai\-powered products.
* balance rapid startup execution with the discipline required for housing\-related data and sensitive user workflows.

**who this role is best suited for**

this position is best suited for an engineer who enjoys working deeply within application logic, databases, apis, integrations, data pipelines, permissions, and production infrastructure.

the ideal candidate is interested in more than creating basic create\-read\-update\-delete endpoints. dwelr’s backend will need to determine how records relate to properties, owners, managers, reports, violations, documents, disputes, and changes over time. the role therefore requires thoughtful data modeling and an appreciation for data quality, provenance, security, and operational reliability.

you should be comfortable working in an early\-stage environment where you may help define the solution rather than receiving a fully specified technical document. you should also be willing to investigate unfamiliar datasets, external systems, and real\-world edge cases.

**why join dwelr**

most renters are expected to make one of their largest monthly financial decisions without meaningful access to a property’s maintenance history, recurring complaints, public violations, ownership structure, management responsiveness, or other important signals.

dwelr is working to organize this fragmented information into structured, understandable, and evidence\-backed residential intelligence.

backend engineering is central to that mission. the usefulness of dwelr will depend on whether the platform can securely collect information, associate it with the correct entities, preserve its source history, enforce appropriate permissions, and make it available through reliable products and apis.

* work on complex real\-world data and identity problems.
* help establish the infrastructure behind dwelr index and dwelr index ai.
* join the company before its planned geographic and product expansion.
* build technology intended to improve transparency and accountability in residential housing.

title: QA & Operations Engineer – Amazon Connect (CCaaS)
description:
about the role

we are looking for a qa \& operations engineer to support the quality assurance, monitoring, and operational stability of our amazon connect contact center platform. this role sits at the intersection of quality engineering, devops, and cloud operations — ensuring that contact flows, integrations, and infrastructure changes are tested, deployed, and monitored reliably across environments (uat → production). the ideal candidate is comfortable both writing test plans for ivr/contact flow behavior and troubleshooting aws infrastructure when something breaks in production.

key responsibilities

quality assurance

* design, execute, and maintain test plans for amazon connect contact flows, routing profiles, queues, and third\-party integrations (e.g., pindrop, salesforce, snowflake).• perform uat\-to\-prod comparison testing to catch configuration drift, arn mismatches, or environment\-specific defects before release.• build and maintain automated test cases for lambda functions supporting ivr logic (e.g., phone verification, customer lookup, call routing).• validate ctr (contact trace record) and contact lens data integrity against expected call outcomes.• perform regression testing after terraform\-managed infrastructure changes (contact flows, views, iam roles, cloudwatch alarms).• document defects clearly with reproduction steps, logs, and environment context; track through resolution.

devops \& release management

* support ci/cd pipelines for deploying amazon connect resources via terraform cloud, including plan review and safe rollout practices.• partner with engineering to validate infrastructure\-as\-code changes (lambda, dynamodb, iam, cloudwatch, connect contact flows/views) prior to production deployment.• maintain deployment runbooks and rollback procedures for contact center releases.• support blue/green or phased rollout strategies for high\-risk changes (e.g., routing logic, security profile updates).

operations \& monitoring

* monitor cloudwatch logs, metrics, and alarms across lambda, connect, and related aws services; triage and escalate anomalies.• participate in incident response for contact center outages — including log group failures, eventbridge rule issues, and token/credential rotation problems.• conduct root\-cause analysis for production issues and produce clear post\-incident reports with remediation recommendations.• track and report on operational kpis (call volume, error rates, latency, abandonment) using quicksight/athena dashboards.• support business continuity planning (bcp) testing, including failover and pstn reroute validation exercises.

data \& security hygiene

* identify and flag data quality issues in call/verification data (e.g., duplicate records, placeholder values) surfaced through qa testing.• support least\-privilege reviews of amazon connect security profiles and iam roles.• ensure no pii (dob, tax id, etc.) or plaintext credentials are exposed in logs; escalate violations immediately.

required qualifications

* 3\+ years of experience in qa, devops, or cloud operations roles, ideally within a contact center or telephony environment.• hands\-on experience with amazon connect (contact flows, routing profiles, queues, views) or comparable ccaas platform.• working knowledge of aws core services: lambda, dynamodb, s3, cloudwatch, iam, eventbridge.• experience with terraform (reading plans, understanding resource diffs, safe apply practices) — terraform cloud experience a plus.• familiarity with ci/cd tooling and release management practices.• strong troubleshooting skills: ability to read logs (cloudwatch logs insights), trace issues across services, and communicate findings clearly.• experience writing and executing structured test plans/test cases for both ui/flow\-based and api/backend components.• basic scripting ability (python, bash, or similar) for test automation and log analysis.

preferred qualifications

* experience with amazon connect contact lens, voice id, or ai\-based qa scoring tools.• exposure to data platforms such as snowflake, athena, or quicksight for operational reporting.• experience integrating third\-party voice/fraud detection platforms (e.g., pindrop).• familiarity with palantir foundry/aip or similar data integration platforms.• aws certification (cloud practitioner, sysops administrator, or developer associate).• experience supporting carrier/telephony migrations or pstn failover planning.• background in agile/scrum environments with tools like jira.

what success looks like in this role

* production incidents are caught in qa/uat before reaching customers.• deployment\-related outages decrease due to rigorous pre\-release testing and monitoring.• operational dashboards give leadership clear, real\-time visibility into contact center health.• security and data quality issues are proactively flagged rather than discovered after the fact.

title: ETL Developer
description:
**etl developer – remote**  

  

**bright vision technologies** is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, ai, data, and enterprise solutions across the united states.  

  

this is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well\-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.  

  

**job title:** etl developer  

**location:** 100% remote (u.s.)  

**position type:** full\-time, direct w2  

**salary range:** $115,000–$175,000 annually  

**experience required:** 5\+ years  

  

**sponsorship:** u.s. citizens, green card holders, ead holders, and h\-1b transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. we are unable to sponsor new h\-1b visa petitions for this position.  

  

**job summary**  

we are seeking an experienced **etl developer** to design, develop, and optimize enterprise\-scale data integration solutions supporting business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, and cloud data modernization initiatives. this role focuses on building high\-performance etl pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from diverse operational systems into enterprise data warehouses and cloud\-based analytics platforms.  

you will collaborate with data architects, data engineers, business analysts, cloud engineers, and bi developers to develop scalable data integration frameworks, automate complex workflows, and ensure the delivery of high\-quality, trusted data across the organization. the ideal candidate combines strong etl development expertise with advanced sql skills, cloud data platform experience, and a deep understanding of data warehousing and enterprise data governance.  

  

**key responsibilities*** design, develop, and maintain enterprise etl/elt pipelines for large\-scale data integration projects.
* build scalable data ingestion workflows that extract data from relational databases, cloud applications, apis, flat files, and enterprise systems.
* develop transformation logic for cleansing, standardizing, validating, and enriching large datasets.
* design and optimize batch and near real\-time data processing pipelines supporting business\-critical reporting and analytics.
* implement slowly changing dimensions (scd), change data capture (cdc), incremental loading strategies, and data reconciliation processes.
* develop reusable etl frameworks, metadata\-driven workflows, and parameterized jobs to improve maintainability.
* perform source\-to\-target mapping, data profiling, and data quality analysis during project implementation.
* optimize etl job performance by improving sql queries, partitioning strategies, indexing, and parallel processing.
* monitor etl workflows, troubleshoot production failures, and implement proactive alerting and recovery mechanisms.
* collaborate with cloud engineers to migrate legacy etl workloads to azure or aws cloud platforms.
* participate in data architecture discussions, code reviews, deployment planning, and production support.
* ensure data security, governance, auditability, and regulatory compliance across enterprise data pipelines.

  

**required skills*** five or more years of professional experience developing enterprise etl solutions.
* strong hands\-on experience with etl platforms such as informatica powercenter, ssis, talend, ibm datastage, or pentaho.
* advanced sql development skills with sql server, oracle, postgresql, snowflake, or teradata.
* strong understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and data warehousing principles.
* experience designing etl workflows involving complex transformations, joins, aggregations, lookups, and data validation.
* hands\-on experience implementing change data capture (cdc), slowly changing dimensions (scd type 1 \& type 2\), and incremental loading techniques.
* experience working with cloud data platforms including azure data factory (adf), aws glue, or google cloud data fusion.
* experience integrating structured and semi\-structured data formats including json, xml, csv, parquet, and avro.
* familiarity with scripting languages such as python, powershell, or shell scripting for etl automation.
* experience scheduling workflows using control\-m, autosys, apache airflow, azure data factory, or enterprise schedulers.
* experience with git, azure devops, jenkins, or other ci/cd tools for etl deployments.
* strong debugging, troubleshooting, and etl performance tuning skills.
* experience working with agile scrum teams and enterprise sdlc processes.

  

**preferred qualifications*** experience with cloud data warehouses including snowflake, azure synapse analytics, amazon redshift, or google bigquery.
* knowledge of apache spark, databricks, pyspark, or distributed data processing frameworks.
* experience implementing enterprise master data management (mdm) and data quality solutions.
* familiarity with streaming technologies including apache kafka, azure event hub, or amazon kinesis.
* experience developing metadata\-driven etl frameworks and reusable integration components.
* knowledge of data vault 2\.0 architecture and modern data lakehouse concepts.
* familiarity with devops practices for data engineering and automated etl deployments.
* experience with bi platforms including power bi, tableau, or qlik for downstream reporting integration.
* understanding of data governance frameworks, lineage, cataloging, and regulatory compliance.
* cloud certifications in azure, aws, snowflake, or informatica are highly desirable.

  

**project environment**  

  

you will be joining an enterprise data engineering team responsible for modernizing data integration and analytics platforms supporting multiple business units across financial services, healthcare, insurance, and retail industries. current initiatives include:* enterprise data warehouse modernization to snowflake and azure synapse
* cloud\-based etl migration from legacy on\-premises platforms
* real\-time data ingestion and analytics pipelines
* customer 360 and master data management initiatives
* regulatory reporting and compliance data solutions
* data lake and lakehouse architecture implementation
* enterprise reporting platforms supporting executive dashboards and operational analytics
* high\-volume data pipelines processing billions of records from erp, crm, hr, and financial systems

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
transflo is a leading provider of mobile, telematics, and business process automation software for the transportation and logistics industry. our solutions help freight carriers, brokers, and shippers automate and streamline their operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. we are on a mission to drive innovation in the industry by providing cutting\-edge saas and ai solutions that enable seamless communication and collaboration across the supply chain.
**description:**
transflo is seeking a senior data engineer to architect and own our enterprise data platform — from raw ingestion through curated, analytics\-ready data products. you will be the foundational engineer behind our data warehouse, data pipeline infrastructure, and the bronze\-silver\-gold medallion architecture that serves internal analytics teams, operational reporting, and our growing data as a service (daas) capability.
this role demands both deep technical expertise and a strategic mindset. you will work across a wide range of source systems — apis, relational databases, nosql stores, file\-based feeds, and streaming data — normalizing and modeling data into reliable, governed, and high\-performance analytical assets. you will build and scale systems designed for near real\-time data environments supporting high\-traffic, mission\-critical workloads in the transportation and logistics industry.
**core areas of responsibility:**
* architect, build, and evolve a scalable enterprise data warehouse on amazon redshift, applying industry\-standard concepts including star schemas, snowflake schemas, normalization, denormalization, referential integrity, and performance optimization strategies
* design and implement bronze, silver, and gold data layer architecture (medallion architecture): raw ingestion, cleansed and standardized intermediate layers, and curated, business\-ready data products optimized for analytics consumption
* develop dimensional data models, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions (scds), and aggregate structures that support bi tooling, ad\-hoc analytics, and downstream api consumption
* apply rigorous data modeling practices including schema design, constraint definition, indexing strategy, sort keys, distribution keys, and query plan optimization within redshift and connected systems
* build, own, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines that ingest data from disparate source systems including rest apis, flat files, ibm db2, mysql, amazon aurora, amazon dynamodb, and postgresql
* implement real\-time and near real\-time data streaming architectures using aws\-native services such as kinesis data streams, kinesis firehose, msk (managed kafka), and eventbridge to support low\-latency data delivery requirements
* design pipeline frameworks for data extraction, transformation, and loading (etl/elt) using tools such as aws glue, dbt, apache airflow, or equivalent orchestration platforms
* ensure pipeline reliability, idempotency, fault tolerance, and automated recovery; build alerting and observability into every data workflow from day one
* own data quality end\-to\-end: design and implement automated profiling, cleansing, deduplication, standardization, and validation frameworks that enforce data integrity at each layer of the medallion architecture
* build and continuously evolve tooling and processes to support data governance including data cataloging, lineage tracking, metadata management, access controls, and data classification
* define and enforce data contracts between source systems and the warehouse, establishing clear slas for freshness, completeness, and accuracy
* partner with data consumers — data scientists, data analytics engineers, bi developers, product managers, and external api clients — to understand consumption patterns and ensure data products meet quality and performance expectations
* support the architecture and buildout of a reliable, scalable data as a service (daas) product, enabling external and internal consumers to access curated transflo data via governed apis and data sharing mechanisms
* contribute to the data platform infrastructure using infrastructure\-as\-code practices (terraform), ensuring all data infrastructure is version\-controlled, reproducible, and auditable
* design for scale: apply partitioning strategies, workload management (wlm) tuning, concurrency scaling, and caching patterns to sustain performance under high\-traffic analytical and operational workloads
* champion security and compliance best practices across the data platform: column\-level security, row\-level access controls, encryption, and audit logging
* collaborate with software engineers, mobile platform teams, and devops to ensure upstream application data is well\-structured, well\-documented, and reliably delivered to the data platform
* leverage ai\-assisted development practices and tooling to accelerate pipeline development, automate data quality checks, and improve engineering velocity

**required experience:**
* 5\+ years of professional data engineering experience with a track record of building and operating production\-grade data warehouses and pipeline infrastructure
* expert\-level experience with amazon redshift including cluster sizing, wlm configuration, distribution and sort key optimization, vacuuming, and query plan analysis
* deep proficiency in sql for complex analytical queries, window functions, ctes, stored procedures, and performance tuning across redshift and ansi\-compatible engines
* hands\-on experience ingesting data from heterogeneous source systems: rest apis, ibm db2, mysql, amazon aurora (mysql and postgresql\-compatible), amazon dynamodb, postgresql, and file\-based sources (csv, json, parquet, avro)
* proven experience designing and implementing medallion (bronze/silver/gold) or equivalent layered data architectures at enterprise scale
* strong working knowledge of star schema and snowflake schema design, dimensional modeling theory, slowly changing dimensions, and fact table granularity decisions
* experience building real\-time or near real\-time data pipelines using streaming technologies such as amazon kinesis, apache kafka (or amazon msk), or equivalent
* proficiency with etl/elt orchestration tools such as aws glue, dbt, apache airflow, or aws step functions
* demonstrated experience implementing data governance practices: data catalogs (aws glue data catalog, apache atlas, or equivalent), lineage, metadata tagging, and access control frameworks
* infrastructure\-as\-code experience with terraform for provisioning and managing data infrastructure on aws
* strong python skills for pipeline development, data transformation logic, and automation scripting
* deep understanding of data reliability engineering: idempotency, exactly\-once processing, late\-arriving data handling, schema evolution, and sla\-driven pipeline design

**skills/experience:**
* experience in the transportation, logistics, trucking, or fleet management industry, or with high\-volume transactional saas platforms processing operational telemetry data is a huge plus
* experience building daas or data product offerings including governed external data apis, redshift data sharing, or aws data exchange integrations
* knowledge of columnar storage formats (parquet, orc) and lakehouse patterns using amazon s3 as a data lake layer in conjunction with redshift spectrum or aws glue
* familiarity with bi and analytics consumption tools such as tableau, power bi, amazon quicksight, or looker and how data model design decisions impact end\-user query performance
* experience with data observability platforms such as monte carlo, great expectations, or dbt tests for automated data quality monitoring
* contributions to reusable data platform tooling, shared dbt packages, or internal data engineering frameworks
* experience working in fully remote, distributed engineering teams

title: Rust Developer
description:
**rust developer – remote**  

  

**bright vision technologies** is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, ai, data, and enterprise solutions across the united states.  

this is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well\-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.  

  

**job title:** rust developer  

**location:** 100% remote (u.s.)  

**position type:** full\-time, direct w2  

**salary range:** $145,000–$205,000 annually  

**experience required:** 6\+ years  

  

**sponsorship:** u.s. citizens, green card holders, ead holders, and h\-1b transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. we are unable to sponsor new h\-1b visa petitions for this position.  

  

**job summary**  

we are seeking an experienced **rust developer** to design, build, and optimize high\-performance distributed systems, low\-latency backend services, and cloud\-native infrastructure components powering mission\-critical enterprise platforms. this role focuses on developing highly concurrent, memory\-safe applications using rust while integrating with modern cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and event\-driven architectures.  

you will work closely with platform engineers, distributed systems architects, devops teams, and product engineering groups to build scalable apis, asynchronous processing pipelines, networking services, and infrastructure automation tools. the ideal candidate has strong systems programming expertise, deep knowledge of concurrent application development, and experience building production software where performance, reliability, and security are critical.  

  

**key responsibilities*** design and develop high\-performance backend services using rust for large\-scale distributed systems.
* build low\-latency apis, asynchronous processing services, and event\-driven microservices.
* develop networking applications utilizing tcp, udp, http/2, grpc, websockets, and quic protocols.
* build highly concurrent applications using rust's async ecosystem including tokio and async/await.
* design resilient services capable of processing millions of transactions with high availability and fault tolerance.
* optimize cpu utilization, memory management, thread scheduling, and application performance.
* integrate services with kafka, rabbitmq, redis streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
* develop secure apis and authentication services supporting oauth2, jwt, openid connect, and mtls.
* build observability capabilities including structured logging, distributed tracing, and performance monitoring.
* participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, system design discussions, and production support.
* collaborate with devops engineers to automate deployments using ci/cd pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* investigate complex production issues involving networking, concurrency, memory utilization, and distributed systems.

  

**required skills*** six or more years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise applications.
* three or more years of hands\-on rust development experience in production environments.
* strong proficiency in rust programming language, ownership model, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, and macros.
* extensive experience with asynchronous rust development using tokio, async/await, futures, and actix or axum.
* strong understanding of concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization primitives, and lock\-free programming concepts.
* experience building restful apis, grpc services, and high\-performance backend applications.
* strong understanding of operating system fundamentals including memory management, process scheduling, file systems, and networking.
* experience working with linux production environments and command\-line tooling.
* experience developing cloud\-native applications on aws, azure, or google cloud platform.
* strong sql skills with postgresql, mysql, or sql server.
* experience working with nosql databases such as redis, cassandra, dynamodb, or mongodb.
* hands\-on experience with git, ci/cd pipelines, docker, and kubernetes.
* experience integrating distributed messaging systems including kafka, rabbitmq, nats, or pulsar.
* strong debugging, profiling, benchmarking, and performance optimization skills.
* experience working in agile development environments.

  

**preferred qualifications*** experience building distributed systems supporting high\-throughput financial, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or telecommunications platforms.
* familiarity with rust web frameworks including axum, warp, rocket, or actix web.
* experience developing kubernetes operators or cloud\-native infrastructure tooling.
* experience with service mesh technologies such as istio or linkerd.
* familiarity with infrastructure as code using terraform or pulumi.
* experience with prometheus, grafana, opentelemetry, and distributed tracing platforms.
* knowledge of cryptographic libraries, tls, secure communications, and certificate management.
* experience building command\-line tools and systems utilities using rust.
* familiarity with c/c\+\+ interoperability through foreign function interface (ffi).
* contributions to open\-source rust projects or participation in the rust community are highly desirable.

  

**project environment**  

you will be joining a platform engineering team responsible for building next\-generation distributed infrastructure supporting enterprise\-scale applications across cloud environments. current initiatives include:* high\-performance api gateway and service mesh components
* real\-time event streaming and data processing pipelines
* distributed job scheduling and workflow orchestration services
* cloud\-native platform services deployed on kubernetes
* secure authentication and identity management infrastructure
* infrastructure automation and systems observability platforms
* high\-availability backend services processing millions of requests daily
* enterprise monitoring, telemetry, and reliability engineering solutions

  

this is a highly technical engineering role where you will contribute to architecture, implementation, performance optimization, deployment, and operational excellence for large\-scale production systems.  

  

**how to apply**

description:

wells fargo is seeking two **senior quantitative analytics specialists (senior genai data scientists)** to support driving natural language processing (nlp) and large language model (llm) initiatives as part of the **consumer model development** group.


this role is ideal for a seasoned professional passionate about building scalable **natural language processing (nlp)** solutions and driving innovation in **large language model (llm)** applications.


learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com.

 **in this role, you will:**

* apply advanced statistical theory to quantify, analyze, and manage data, financial risks, and market dynamics through robust modeling approaches

* demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, and exercise sound judgment within a matrixed environment to drive business outcomes

title: Data Scientist
description:
**introduction:**
-----------------


we are seeking a data scientist to join our team. the data scientist will be responsible for designing, developing, evaluating, and optimizing machine learning models that solve complex business problems for our enterprise clients. this role collaborates closely with business partners, engineers, and client stakeholders to deliver scalable ai solutions while ensuring models continue to perform effectively in production environments.

**what you'll do:**
-------------------

* collaborate with business and technical teams to define machine learning objectives, success metrics, and measurable outcomes.
* identify, ingest, transform, and enrich structured and unstructured data for model development.
* engineer features from structured and text\-based data, including entity extraction, normalization, embeddings, and feature generation.
* apply statistical and machine learning techniques including classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning models.
* design and execute experiments including a/b testing, hypothesis testing, causal analysis, and model benchmarking.
* build production\-ready machine learning models using python and spark.
* design automated evaluation methodologies including benchmark datasets, acceptance tests, and promotion gates.
* monitor production model performance, identify model drift and degradation, and continuously improve model accuracy through retraining and optimization.
* develop scalable machine learning solutions that integrate with enterprise ai platforms.
* present methodologies, findings, and recommendations to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

**who you are:**
----------------

* passionate about solving business problems through data science and artificial intelligence.
* experienced working with large\-scale enterprise data environments.
* comfortable owning machine learning models throughout their lifecycle from development through production.
* strong analytical thinker with excellent problem\-solving abilities.
* fast learner with attention to detail.
* outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* able to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and client stakeholders.


education: bachelor's or master's degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or another quantitative field.


related work experience: 3\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics.

**technical skills:**
---------------------

* advanced sql
* python (numpy, pandas, scikit\-learn, tensorflow, pytorch)
* apache spark / pyspark
* aws sagemaker (databricks, azure ml, or vertex ai experience is a plus)
* natural language processing (nlp), embeddings, entity extraction, and feature engineering
* statistical modeling, regression, experimental design, hypothesis testing, and drift analysis
* automated testing and data validation
* experience deploying and supporting production machine learning models
* git and modern software development practices

**our purpose and culture:**


at bdiplus, our mission is to help enterprises utilize their resources more efficiently, implement effective information management and empower them by enabling richer insights and intelligence.


we are driven by a single purpose: empower the technology transformation. we are passionate about creating foundational technology platforms for enterprise data and information management. our employees are at the heart of the work we do at bdiplus. we are committed to encouraging and celebrating innovation, creativity, and hard work among our team members.


working at bdiplus offers:

* a diverse, fun to work with, highly intelligent and innovative team.
* full health and commuter benefits.
* a competitive salary and an annual bonus.
* standard time off, sick leave, and time off on all national holidays.
* visa sponsorship
* an environment where creative thinking is encouraged and innovation is a driving force of everything we do.

title: Full Stack Data Engineer
description:
cavaliers holdings llc is obsessed with delivering epic experiences for our team members, our fans, our community and the world. fueled by an unapologetically bold, inclusive and high\-impact culture, we strive to recruit individuals who are enthusiastic and purposeful in carrying out our vision as transformative leaders in sports and entertainment. if you are ready to bring your best to the dynamic, high performance environment of the cavs, cleveland wnba, monsters, charge, resn and rocket arena \- where we come together to create moments that move, inspire, and uplift \- then we want to hear from you.
  
  

**job summary:**  

we're hiring a full\-stack data engineer to join a small, high\-trust team building the systems that fuel decisions across the organization. this is a two\-sided role by design: you'll build and own the data pipelines that feed our warehouse and the applications and interfaces that put that data in the hands of business users. the systems you build won't stop at a table — they'll go all the way through to something a stakeholder actually uses. if you want to be a pure data engineer forever, this isn't the seat. we want engineers who move fluidly between pipeline work and application work because that's how our team ships end\-to\-end value.
  
  

**essential duties \& responsibilities:**  

* design, build, and maintain production data pipelines feeding our aurora postgresql warehouse and downstream analytics
* own dbt models end\-to\-end: sources, staging, marts, tests, documentation
* improve pipeline reliability: monitoring, alerting, incident response, root\-cause analysis
* build and maintain internal applications, apis, and integrations that expose data to business teams in ticketing, marketing, sales, and big (business intelligence group)
* integrate with vendor systems and third\-party apis to move data in and out of the platform
* partner directly with business stakeholders and analysts to translate a business need into a shipped system
* choose the right solution (build, buy, configure, automate, or advise), not the most engineering\-intensive one
* contribute to platform decisions: tooling, standards, architecture
* write change notices, code reviews, and documentation


**required qualifications:**  

* 4–6 years of hands\-on engineering experience in a production environment, spanning both data engineering and application/backend development
* strong dbt experience — you've built and maintained a real dbt project, not just run through a tutorial
* deep sql fluency and comfort with structured/relational databases (postgresql preferred; snowflake, redshift, bigquery all translate)
* demonstrated experience designing and operating data pipelines (orchestration, dependencies, retries, observability)
* demonstrated experience building applications, apis, or services that non\-engineers actually use in production
* working proficiency with ai coding tools (claude code, codex, cursor, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day engineering practice — you can speak to what you've built with them and where they break down
* python proficiency for pipeline logic, transformations, and glue code
* version control (git), code review, and ci/cd hygiene
* aws experience (rds/aurora, lambda, s3, iam)
* experience with dbt\-osmosis, dbt docs, or similar metadata tooling
* frontend/ui experience for internal tooling (any modern framework)
* exposure to sports, entertainment, ticketing, or crm data models
* background integrating vendor apis (ticketmaster, salesforce, adobe, etc.)
* comfort with light devops (terraform, github actions)


we are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.
  
  

actual compensation will depend on your experience, education/credentials, skills, and how they fit our organizational needs. rock entertainment group offers a robust perks package with healthcare, dental, vision, retirement, and more!

title: Specialist Software Engineering
description:
**job family**


it \- development**about us**

  

at transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. we understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. we embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

  

ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

  



**who we are**

  

we believe everyone deserves to live their best life. more than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in america to serve everyday people from all walks of life.


today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.


we’re empowered by a vast agent network covering north america, with diversity to match. together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. united in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

**what we do**

  

transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. these include 1\) world financial group, including transamerica financial advisors, 2\) protection solutions and savings \& investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and transamerica investment solutions, and 3\) financial assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. these are supported by transamerica corporate, which includes finance, people and places, general counsel, risk, internal audit, strategy and development, and corporate affairs, which covers communications, brand, and government and policy affairs.

  

transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. it’s part of aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* for more information, visit transamerica.com.

**job description summary**


the specialist software engineer is focused on the design and development of web and cloud technologies to support an agile digital business. helps define web and cloud strategies, grow capabilities, and develops enterprise\-wide solutions by providing technology leadership, insight on new developments within the application solution space, and guidance in design, framework, and platform decisions.**job description**

**responsibilities**

* lead analysis and complex architectural design across platforms toward the development of end\-to\-end solutions; translate architectural guidance into detailed technical design.
* lead committees or projects to help define organization\-wide standards, processes, and guidelines.
* work collaboratively with other development staff, including contract and offshore software engineers, and business product owners in an agile environment.
* code, test, identify, implement, and document solutions to business challenges utilizing web and cloud technologies.
* perform design and analysis for deliverables. lead large team design sessions.
* serve as a subject matter expert for a wide range of areas, applications, and technologies;
* recommend solutions which take into consideration costs, business needs, and system impacts.
* utilize third\-party software development frameworks, open\-source libraries, and apis to rapidly develop basic application solutions.
* lead web development staff, including contract and off\-shore developers; may have supervisory responsibility over employees.
* learn and keep pace with the latest advances in the field and rapidly grasp new technologies to support the environment and contribute to project deliverables.
* prepare presentations and lead development meetings.

 **qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, math, engineering, or other technical field, or equivalent experience
* six years of core java or.net experience
* expertise in coding platforms/frameworks (e.g. .net/c\#, java, ood, oop, functional programming, spring framework, j2ee development, oop, service oriented architecture, dependency injection, and core architecture)
* five years of experience and expertise in database design techniques and philosophies (e.g. rdbms, document, star schema, kimball model)
* in\-depth knowledge of nosql database technologies (e.g. ms cosmos db, apache cassandra, amazon dynamodb)
* three years of development experience with cloud services (e.g. aws/azure) utilizing various support tools (e.g. ec2, ecs, s3, kinesis, vms, blob, cosmos, data factory, sql data warehouse, arm templates, event hubs)
* expertise in build and deployment tools \- (visual studio, git/bitbucket, maven, jenkins, nexus, sql management studio, nunit, ajax)
* expertise in developing distributed computing (ms hpc, sagemaker, spark)
* five years of experience with integration and service frameworks (e.g. api gateways, apache camel, swagger api, zookeeper, kafka, messaging tools, microservices)
* expertise with microservices and rest based api development (e.g. spring boot, spring mvc, entity framework, iis, swagger, odata, .net api 2, .net api core, automapper)
* experience leveraging continuous integration/development tools (e.g. jenkins, docker, containers, openshift, kubernetes, and container automation) in a ci/cd pipeline
* familiarity with modern frontend development frameworks (angular, react, vue.js, asp.net mvc, http, html, js, css, ajax)
* advanced understanding of software development and research tools
* attention to detail and results oriented, with a strong customer focus
* ability to work as part of a team and independently
* analytical and problem\-solving skills
* technical communication skills and the ability to present information to all levels of the organization
* problem\-solving and technical communication skills
* ability to prioritize workload to meet tight deadlines

 **preferred qualifications**

* master’s degree
* understanding of advanced analytics and machine learning concepts and technology implementations
* experience with big data and real time streaming analytics processing architecture
* experience with data warehousing architecture and implementation, including source to target mappings and etl.
* technology or platform certifications (e.g. aws, microsoft)
* knowledge of the financial services industry

 **working conditions**

* office environment
